Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, positive leukocyte esterase, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Hematuria is present, but no casts are seen. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation for UTI, consider antibiotic therapy, and further evaluation if hematuria persists.
